active.counterpart: a hiring manager at a logistics company

brief.setting: A job interview for a logistics coordinator role.
keyPhrases: I would like to learn more about
coreExchanges: Why do you want this job?
Describe a difficult day at work
Do you have any questions for us?

hardMoments.label: A misunderstanding
hardMoments.prompt: Speak quickly and use an idiom.

presets.title: Job interview
presets.blurb: A hiring manager asks about you and the job.

stages.goal: The key phrases for an interview
The interview, from hello to your own questions
The salary question, a gap in your CV, a question you missed

keyPhrases.text: Thank you for having me.
I have experience in this area.
keyPhrases.meaning: You have done this kind of work before.

keyPhrases.text: One of my strengths is working in a team.
keyPhrases.meaning: You are good at working with other people.

keyPhrases.text: I am available to start in two weeks.
keyPhrases.meaning: You can begin work in two weeks.

keyPhrases.text: Could you tell me more about the role?
keyPhrases.meaning: Ask for more details about the job.

keyPhrases.text: I am looking for a chance to learn and grow.
keyPhrases.meaning: You want to build your skills.

keyPhrases.text: Could you repeat the question, please?
keyPhrases.meaning: Ask them to say it again.

keyPhrases.text: Thank you for your time.

presets.title: Talking to my manager
presets.blurb: A short one-to-one: your work, a request, some feedback.

stages.goal: The key phrases for talking to a manager
An update, a request and next steps
Tough feedback, a polite no, a fast instruction

keyPhrases.text: Do you have a few minutes to talk?
keyPhrases.meaning: Ask if it is a good time.

keyPhrases.text: I wanted to give you an update on my work.
keyPhrases.meaning: You want to say how things are going.

keyPhrases.text: I am finding this task difficult.
keyPhrases.meaning: Say politely that you need help.

keyPhrases.text: Could I ask for a day off next week?
keyPhrases.meaning: A polite request for time off.

keyPhrases.text: Could you explain that again, please?
Can we go through the priorities?
I understand. I will do that today.
Thank you for your feedback.

presets.title: Doctor's appointment
presets.blurb: A receptionist, then a doctor. Booking and describing how you feel, in simple words.

stages.goal: The key phrases for booking and saying how you feel
Booking in, then seeing the doctor
A question you did not catch, a word you do not know, a time that is full

keyPhrases.text: I would like to make an appointment.
keyPhrases.meaning: You want to book a visit.

keyPhrases.text: Do you have anything tomorrow morning?
I have had a headache since Monday.
keyPhrases.meaning: Say what hurts and for how long.

keyPhrases.text: It hurts here.
keyPhrases.meaning: Point and say where it hurts.

keyPhrases.text: I have had a fever since yesterday.
keyPhrases.meaning: Say how long you have felt hot and unwell.

keyPhrases.text: I feel very tired.
Could you speak more slowly, please?
Could you say that again, please?
Thank you, I understand.

presets.title: Apartment viewing or landlord
presets.blurb: A landlord shows you a place to rent. You ask your questions.

stages.goal: The key phrases for a viewing
The visit, from hello to your decision
A question about you, a small problem, something you do not understand

keyPhrases.text: Thank you for showing me the flat.
How much is the rent per month?
Are the bills included?
keyPhrases.meaning: Ask if water, power and heating are in the price.

keyPhrases.text: Is the flat furnished?
Could I see the kitchen, please?
When could I move in?
I would like to think about it.
keyPhrases.meaning: A polite way to say you need time.

keyPhrases.text: Could you send me the details by email?
keyPhrases.meaning: Ask for the information in writing.

presets.title: Opening a bank account
presets.blurb: A bank clerk helps you open a simple account.

stages.goal: The key phrases for the bank desk
From hello to signing the form
Spelling your details, a fee question, a missing document

keyPhrases.text: I would like to open a bank account.
What do I need to bring?
Is there a monthly fee?
keyPhrases.meaning: Ask if the account costs money each month.

keyPhrases.text: How does the card work?
Where do I sign?
keyPhrases.meaning: Ask where to put your name.

keyPhrases.text: How long will it take?
Could I have a copy, please?
Could you speak more slowly, please?

presets.title: Parent-teacher meeting
presets.blurb: You talk with your child's teacher about how school is going.

stages.goal: The key phrases for a school meeting
How your child is doing, and how you can help
A worry about behaviour, a fast explanation, a request for help at home

keyPhrases.text: How is my child doing in class?
What is going well?
What can we do at home to help?
My child says the homework is hard.
keyPhrases.meaning: Share what you heard at home.

keyPhrases.text: Could you explain that in simpler words?
Is my child happy at school?
keyPhrases.meaning: Ask about how your child feels.

keyPhrases.text: When is the next meeting?
Thank you for your time.

presets.title: First day at work or school
presets.blurb: You meet your manager or teacher and the team on day one.
presets.counterpart: my new manager and the team

stages.goal: The key phrases for a first day
Meeting people and finding your way
Many names at once, a fast instruction, small talk

keyPhrases.text: Nice to meet you.
I am happy to be here.
keyPhrases.meaning: Say you are glad to start.

keyPhrases.text: Where should I put my things?
keyPhrases.meaning: Ask where to leave your bag.

keyPhrases.text: Who should I ask if I have a question?
What time do we have lunch?
Could you show me how this works?
Sorry, could you repeat your name?
keyPhrases.meaning: Ask someone to say their name again.

keyPhrases.text: Thank you for your help.

presets.title: Customer service call
presets.blurb: A phone call about a problem with an order or a bill.

stages.goal: The key phrases for a phone call
Explaining the problem and agreeing what happens next
Being put on hold, spelling your details, no answer today

keyPhrases.text: I am calling about my order.
I have a problem with my bill.
keyPhrases.meaning: Say that something is wrong with a bill.

keyPhrases.text: It has not arrived yet.
Let me give you my order number.
keyPhrases.meaning: Offer the number the agent needs.

keyPhrases.text: Could you spell that, please?
keyPhrases.meaning: Ask for the letters one by one.

keyPhrases.text: Could you check that for me, please?
keyPhrases.meaning: Ask the agent to look it up.

keyPhrases.text: Could you send me a confirmation by email?
Could you speak more slowly, please?
